name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement imaginary-time evolution classicall
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement imaginary-time evolution classically (via scipy expm of -tau*H) to find the ground state of the 4-qubit transverse Ising model (J=1.24, h=1.01), and verify by overlapping the result with a Qiskit-exact eigenvector. Your answer must be the complete working code only, runnable from top to bottom.
